Remark
Source: topping:page-0081 1. ch7:1.2\group compactness-manifolds If every $(\M _i,g_i)$ is the same pointed manifold $(\mathcal{N},h)$, then the choice of base points $q$ gives convergence to $(\mathcal{N},h,q)$, whereas a sequence of base points $s_i$ can give a cylindrical limit.
